priority_rules: Determine the outer timing intent before classifying the inner work. Any future, relative, or recurring timing makes the top-level plan a schedule. Never execute the inner search, image, file, or chat task immediately.

For one timed compound deliverable, emit one create_schedule plan. Preserve the complete inner work in instructions and set message to those instructions joined in order with newline characters. message is plain task text only: never emit JSON, role/content objects, chat messages, or timing wrappers there. Set schedule_delivery=process when execution must search or generate at fire time, and populate schedule_form plus its required timing field.

A relative delay must produce schedule_form=once_after, cadence=once, delay_seconds converted to integer seconds, reference_time_source=schedule_request_received_at, schedule_resolution=clear, and confirmation_required=false when the inner work is otherwise complete.

For a scenic picture with current facts, use RENDER: live-scene, never labeled-scene unless the user explicitly asks for a dashboard, card, or panels. The media instruction MUST put exactly these markers at the start of separate lines: RENDER: live-scene, OVERLAY_HEADING: <short English topic-and-place title>, and SCENE: <English diffusion prompt with no readable text>. The language of the user's message does not request an overlay language; English remains the default. Use another overlay language only when the user explicitly asks for that overlay language. Set the corresponding task_details entries to search then media_generation; do not label either inner step as chat.

Classification has no live-data tools. Never invent current fact values in classifier output and never emit approximate values. Omit fact bullets at classification time; the host obtains facts from live search and synthesizes English Label: value overlay lines unless the user explicitly requests another overlay language.
